description: Machine-readable facts about the ewe project. Curated mirror of the vault's reference sheets; validated by .vault/vault-check.sh. Humans read the Markdown notes; agents read this.

repos.name: ewe
repos.role: desktop environment + ewe package + CLI tools + design system

repos.name: ewe-browser
repos.role: ewe browser: the desktop's browser, files and music app (replaced Helium); 0.4.0-beta (2026-10-18): fills logins with Safe only (decision 40), site permissions ask per site (decision 42), Privacy and security, site search

repos.name: ewe-companion
repos.role: desktop companion, shown as Shaun: ewe-companiond daemon, ewe-companion CLI + Claude Code hook relay, Claude Code plugin; later a Tauri window (RFC-007; 0.2.1-beta released 2026-10-18 after 0.2.0-beta the same day, first release 0.1.0-beta 2026-10-17; package in [ewe], opt-in)

repos.name: ewe-safe
repos.role: Safe, the password manager: one KDBX 4 file in a place you pick, ewe-safed daemon, ewe-safe CLI, the ewe-safe-app window, passkeys, SSH keys + an ssh-agent (RFC-008; 0.1.0-beta released 2026-10-15, 0.2.0-beta the same day; opt-in from [ewe])

repos.name: ewe-plugin-passwords
repos.role: add-on: password fill (1.3.0, vendored in ewe 0.28.0-beta)

repos.name: ewe-plugin-cast
repos.role: add-on: Cast to TV (shell end of ewe-castd)

repos.name: ewe-plugin-safe
repos.role: plugin ewe.safe: Safe's bar lock, Quick Access (Super+Shift+P), Quick settings tile (1.0.0, API 3; vendored in ewe 0.27)

repos.name: ewe-plugin-companion
repos.role: plugin ewe.companion, shown as Shaun (decision 39): the island in the bar's centre + the card drop (RFC-007; 0.5.0, vendored in ewe 0.30.0-beta, opt-in)

rules: ewe-conf is the only writer of ewe.conf
secrets never enter ewe.conf or any synced file
layer-shell surfaces stay in the shell
every CLI tool prints JSON and exits 0
nothing else has a sync button
never edit generated files or deployed ~/.config
arch only, pacman only, no partial upgrades
state that outlives the shell lives outside the shell
the design system is the source of truth for every surface

sync_contract.guard: If-Match on the ETag recorded at the last sync (412 = remote newer); a moved ETag over bytes this machine last pushed/pulled or has in flight (sync.json sha256/pending) is adopted, not a conflict (D12)
sync_contract.owner: ewe-sync only - nothing else has a sync button
sync_contract.status_conflict: sync-status answers conflict: remote-newer | remote-exists | null, and remote_is_this_machine; error is the transport error only
sync_contract.machine_id: ewe.conf.meta.json carries machine_id = sha256('ewe-conf:' + /etc/machine-id)[:16] (never the raw id) beside the hostname
sync_contract.stamp_missing: a push whose file landed but whose meta stamp was refused is ok with warning stamp-missing (recorded)
sync_contract.folder_list: [[sync.folders]] is SHARED in ewe-conf sync (2026-10-31); sync.enabled/provider/server/user/folder/browser stay per machine (LOCAL_ONLY)
sync_contract.folder_triggers: automatic = local inotify (5 s quiet) + the account folder's ETag (PROPFIND, every 45 s) + a catch-up after start; or interval; or login; pause per machine
sync_contract.one_engine_per_folder: no pair on the home folder, inside another pair, inside the account mount, or on a Nextcloud-desktop-app folder; the app's folders are shown and can be taken over; ewe-files never mounts over files
sync_contract.published_state: ~/.local/state/ewe/sync-folders.json (version 1) — the connected folders for every app; ~/.local/state/ewe/sync-now = the Sync now nudge (epoch ms)
sync_contract.browser: under ewe the browser syncs when the ewe account is signed in and sync.browser is not false; no toggle of its own
sync_contract.e2e: ewe-sync/tests/e2e-nextcloud.sh: real Nextcloud (podman, 127.0.0.1) + two sandboxed computers + real nextcloudcmd 35.0.0 — ALL PASS 2026-10-31

known_limits: Komble: not yet run against a live pacman
ewe-cast Chromecast: seconds of latency (HLS); true mirroring is a future milestone
ewe-repo: packages unsigned (SigLevel = Optional TrustAll) until signing ships
ewe-sync: cannot create Nextcloud accounts; no selective sync inside a pair; no bandwidth limits (nextcloudcmd 35 has --unsyncedfolders/--uplimit; not wired)
Google Gmail: restricted scope - <=100 test users without a CASA audit

addons.model: D1-D8 (2026-10-04, ewe 0.25.0-beta): first-party plugins vendored in the payload, not installed on a fresh machine, one-time migration for upgraders. Called 'add-ons' in 0.25.0; one name 'plugins' since D9 (2026-10-10)
addons.payload: plugins/<id>/ + plugins/bundle.json (repo, commit, version, default, migrate) written by scripts/vendor-plugins.sh
addons.install: ewe-plugin install <id> | Komble --addons (page 'Plugins') | Welcome Plugins step
addons.migrate_marker: ~/.local/state/ewe/addons-migrated (JSON list of considered ids; local, never synced)
addons.preinstalled: shell core (bar, launcher, Overview, Quick settings basics, notifications, lock, OSD, polkit, Welcome), ewe-settings, Komble, ewe-sync, ewe browser
addons.keybind_rule: manifest keybind target must be the plugin id or one of its ipcAliases (apiVersion >= 3); ipcAliases are ewe.* only
addons.system_install_command: bash /usr/share/ewe/install.sh --no-packages as the user (exits 2 under sudo)
addons.options: Komble Options dialog (Settings, In the bar, On the desktop); komble --options=<id> (D10)
addons.show_in_bar: ewe-plugin bar <id> on|off -> desktop.bar.show."plugin:<id>"; manifest barWidget/barStatus defaultShown, toggle (D10)
addons.setting_legacy: first-party settings may declare legacy: '<ewe.conf key>' whose value stands until set (Dock autohide/icon_size <- desktop.dock.*)

safe_contract.status: released 2026-10-18: Safe 0.3.0-beta (ewe-safe#18, contract docs/SYSTEM.md: login unlock, keyring repair, cards and addresses) + ewe 0.31.0-beta (ewe#64); before: 2026-10-15 Safe 0.2.0-beta (ewe-safe#10-#13 via #14, #15) + ewe 0.28.0-beta (ewe#58, #59), contract docs/TRIO.md; PROTOCOL.md stays v1 (additive)
safe_contract.reference_syntax: safe://<folder>/<title>/<field> | safe://<title>/<field> (any folder) | safe:///<title>/<field> (top) | safe://<item-id>/<field>; '/' in a title = %2F; {{ safe://... }} inside text in run/inject

summary_fields_added.card: {brand, last4, expiry, holder} or null — never the number, the code or the PIN

safe_contract.passkey_format: KeePassXC 2.7.7+: KPEX_PASSKEY_CREDENTIAL_ID (protected), KPEX_PASSKEY_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM (protected), KPEX_PASSKEY_RELYING_PARTY, KPEX_PASSKEY_USERNAME, KPEX_PASSKEY_USER_HANDLE (protected), KPEX_PASSKEY_FLAG_BE/_BS, tag Passkey
safe_contract.ssh_key_format: KeeAgent: OpenSSH private key attachment + KeeAgent.settings; passphrase in the password; public_key + fingerprint plain fields; custom data ewe.kind = ssh-key
safe_contract.ssh_public_cache: ~/.local/state/ewe/safe/ssh-public.json (public keys + titles, 0600, only while the agent is on, never synced)
safe_contract.ssh_env_file: ~/.config/environment.d/90-ewe-safe-ssh.conf (SSH_AUTH_SOCK for new sessions); until 0.3.x ~/.ssh/config was never edited, since 0.4.0-beta (building) Safe owns two lines on its top (ssh_gate)

ewe_conf_keys_added.safe.ssh_agent: bool, false until ewe-safe ssh enable; shared: since 0.4.0-beta every computer turns its SSH gate on/off from it
ewe_conf_keys_added.safe.ssh_confirm: first-use (default) | every-time | never — noise reduction, not a security boundary
ewe_conf_keys_added.safe.unlock_at_login: bool, default true — Safe opens at login when login unlock is on (ewe 0.31.0-beta)
ewe_conf_keys_added.safe.confirm_cards: bool, default true — a card fill needs a password typed in the last 5 minutes (ewe 0.31.0-beta)
ewe_conf_keys_added.safe.git_sign: SHA256 fingerprint of the commit-signing key, empty = none; shared (Safe 0.4.0-beta, building)

safe_contract.origin_rule: the browser decides the origin and RP ID; Safe checks only shapes
safe_contract.browser_fill: Safe only since ewe browser 0.4.0-beta (decision 40): no ewe-pass route in the browser; Ctrl+Shift+L, the key and the page menu open Safe's list; password-manager extensions refused before they load (36 Web Store ids, best effort). The desktop's Super+P keeps ewe-pass
safe_contract.login_unlock: Safe 0.3.0-beta: master password sealed under W (master.wrap), W under Argon2id(login password; 64 MiB, t=3, p=2) (login.key), XChaCha20-Poly1305, ~/.local/state/ewe/safe/, never synced; checked with unix_chkpwd (NUL-ended stdin) by the CLI/window; 5 tries then the master password; W carried in gnome-keyring's login keyring so Safe opens at login (never prompts). Our own PAM module pam_ewe_safe.so is parked for the owner's review
safe_contract.keyring: Safe 0.3.0-beta: ewe-safe keyring status|repair|list|import --dry-run against the running keyring; repair copies other collections into login and points default at login, deleting nothing. Safe's own Secret Service server is built but adopt refuses until the login module ships
safe_contract.card_fields: KDBX: custom data ewe.kind = card; Cardholder, Number (protected), Expiry (MM/YYYY), Security code (protected), PIN (protected), Brand; address: Full name, Organization, Address line 1/2, City, Region, Postal code, Country, Phone, Email

ssh_gate.gate: two lines on TOP of ~/.ssh/config: a comment + 'Include ~/.ssh/ewe-safe/config' (Host * IdentityAgent = Safe's socket; GlobalKnownHostsFile adds ~/.ssh/ewe-safe/known_hosts); first value wins; backup ~/.ssh/config.before-safe once; ssh disable removes only Safe's lines/files
ssh_gate.follows_account: [safe] ssh_agent and [safe] git_sign are shared in ewe.conf; ewe-safed converges each computer at start and on a settings re-read
ssh_gate.public_key_files: ~/.ssh/ewe-safe/key-<tag>.pub, tag = first 16 chars of the SHA256 fingerprint (+ -> -, / -> _)
ssh_gate.owners: keys + signing = Safe; which agent = Safe (gate); host definitions = ewe-conf [[network.ssh.hosts]]; ewe computers = ewe-remote (per-computer key); service web page = ewe browser
ssh_gate.signing: git config --global gpg.format ssh, user.signingkey <pub file>, gpg.ssh.program ewe-safe-ssh-sign, commit.gpgsign, tag.gpgsign, gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile ~/.ssh/ewe-safe/allowed_signers

companion_protocol.status: P2.9 (ewe-companion#1 + ewe-plugin-companion#1) released in ewe-companion 0.1.0-beta (2026-10-17); wave 2 (ewe-companion#3 + ewe-plugin-companion#3, 0.5.0) released in ewe-companion 0.2.0-beta + ewe 0.30.0-beta (2026-10-18); docs/PROTOCOL.md, additive only
companion_protocol.rules: values never cross (Safe copies itself; never show/reveal); names stay local (island only, never a model, log or companion.db); tests/canary.sh in CI; commands that print a password manager's values are refused; since 0.2.0-beta the browser's tab, bookmark, download and workspace names and Bluetooth device names stay local too (tests/canary.sh 9)
